newsitem.title: CANADA: Marsulex completes IPO for C$52.5 mln proceeds.
newsitem.headline: Marsulex completes IPO for C$52.5 mln proceeds.

text.p: Environmental services company Marsulex Inc said on Monday it has completed its initial public offering through a rights issue.
The company said the rights offering was fully subscribed and raised total proceeds of C$52.5 million. A total of 10.5 million new Marsulex shares were issued under the offering.

Following the rights offer, Marsulex has 26.79 million common and 4.71 million non-voting shares issued and outstanding. Harrowston Inc owns 13.68 million common shares, or 51.0 percent of the commons shares, and 43.4 percent of the issued and outstanding shares of the company.
Marsulex shares will be listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol MLX as of December 24 and are currently listed on the Winnipeg exchange.
